decision.rationale: TXN-007976 is a charge of 237.45 EUR (23745 minor units) from Bramble Clothing (MER-000024) on card CRD-000155, posted on 2026-09-07. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, which is 51 days after posting. That is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000033 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-15. The dispute was opened 43 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period has passed. The case has no carrier delivery confirmation, so nothing shows delivery to the cardholder. DOC-000034 is an email from the cardholder to the merchant dated 2026-09-21 asking where the order was, with no reply received. The card shows no refund from the merchant, so the merchant has not resolved the matter. The policy says that when the wait has passed, no record shows delivery and the merchant has not resolved the matter, the bank asks the merchant for proof of delivery to the cardholder. None of the documents contained instructions to the bank.

proposed_actions.note: For the order placed on 2026-09-06 for 237.45 EUR, please provide the carrier's delivery record. It should show delivery to the cardholder's address, with the delivery date and the signature of the person who received it.
